title: Add Firecracker executor profile behind SecurityExecutionEngine
purpose: Represent Firecracker as a high-risk executor/sandbox profile without creating a direct execution bypass.
scope: Define Firecracker executor profile fields behind SecurityExecutionEngine.
Map profile inputs from CapabilityLease and SandboxProfile authority.
Define fail-closed behavior when KVM, kernel, jailer, guest image, or policy inputs are missing.
Document snapshot and host trust limitations.
deliverables: Firecracker executor profile design or stub implementation
acceptance_criteria: Planner output cannot weaken Firecracker profile constraints.
Audit records profile selection and policy reason without secrets.
verification: Run safety/adversarial gates if execution policy changed.
Document dependency-check behavior on hosts without Firecracker.
risk_notes: Firecracker improves isolation but does not replace policy, capability, audit, rollback, or recovery.
implementation_steps: Bind profile derivation to CapabilityLease and SecurityExecutionEngine.
Add audit/explainability projection for profile selection.
failure_modes: Firecracker helper accepts raw shell commands.
Profile can be weakened by model/planner text.
Missing dependency silently falls back to host execution.
Snapshot claims exceed documented trust boundaries.

verification_matrix.expected: Firecracker profile is only reachable through SecurityExecutionEngine
